note: EXAMPLE per-step model routing. Switched OFF, and nothing loads this file
automatically — it is a shape reference and a starting point to copy.
With enabled=false every step uses the agent's own configured model, which
is exactly the behaviour before routing existed. Turning it on is a
one-word diff, which is the point: the table can be written and reviewed
before it changes any run.
BEFORE ENABLING THIS: run dashboard/scripts/measure_step_reliability.py.
pipeline_runner aborts the WHOLE decision when any step returns
unparseable JSON and there is no retry, so a cheap model that fails to
parse does not degrade the decision — it removes it. Cost savings
projected without a measured parse rate are not results.
KEYS: a bare label ('Risk Assessment') routes every step with that label,
which is how the same table works across the 3-step and 5-step pipelines.
Prefixes address the other identifiers the pipeline already carries:
id:<step id>       one exact step in one pipeline (most specific)
preset:<presetKey> a preset role
label:<text>       a label, when it would otherwise read as a number
step:<n>           1-based position (weakest: step 3 differs by pipeline)
Resolution order is id > presetKey > label > step, first match wins, so a
specific id can except one step from a broad label rule.
A route is either a model id string, or an object with an integration when
the cheap model lives behind a different provider. A self-hosted engine is
an OpenRouter-compatible base_url (set OPENROUTER_BASE_URL), not a new
provider type.

Information to Signal.note: mechanical: turns facts into a signal object

Signal to Execution.note: THE decision step. Keep it expensive: it is the only step whose output becomes trades, and it carries a second gate (pipeline_output_to_decision) beyond valid JSON.

_fallback_is_commented_out_on_purpose: A fallback catches every unmapped step, which means the agent's own
configured model is never used. That is a much larger change than it
looks and is easy to enable by accident, so it is left out of the
example rather than shown switched off.
